reviewed_workflows.assessment: Matching successful acknowledgements update the committed baseline; failures keep staged values available. The source now prevents Apply/Save while a nonempty source/destination mapping remains unadded, explains that Add is required, and leaves Discard available. Save-to-profile is separate from durable profile Save. Backend Output command errors are emitted as acknowledged terminal results, so the earlier false-ACK busy-state concern is not reachable through those command failures. Delayed successful acknowledgements identify the original user in status even when the chooser changes, and selection clears stale status; a focused unit test covers this attribution.

Save/Load remain the visible primary profile actions. Import/export, recovery, automatic targeting scope, and backend runtime are default-closed disclosures. Session routing disables file mutation and target-scope edits. Output conversion remains unavailable for physical mouse users; key output without a virtual keyboard cannot commit. The 141902 minimum screenshot was scrolled past Save/Load and owned feedback because the next Import observer auto-scrolled during sample wait. The existing wrapped feedback was moved before explanatory copy; the layout gate inserts a same-Save Tab fence and captures after persisted file/snapshot equality and visible Saved status. The replacement frame is pending.

Phosphor Light includes CARET_DOWN at U+E136, with Ouroboros icon_right as a source-only combined-fix recommendation.
